$comment: Import spellings a consumer of @kingsleyweb/bun-auth writes, checked against the packed tarball by `bun scripts/consumer-check.ts packages/bun-auth` from the repo root. Every spelling here worked at some point; removing one hides a regression. better-auth is the app's own (a required peer), so the consumer installs the version the repository tests. better-auth's own declarations name DOM globals (HeadersInit, JsonWebKey) that Bun's types do not declare, so its consumers type-check with the DOM lib, as an app using better-auth must (evidence: 25 errors inside better-auth, with or without bun-auth, under lib ESNext and skipLibCheck off).

A plain Bun.serve, without bun-common's router.
better-auth's database adapter on bun-sql (an optional peer this entry needs). Checked in a consumer with bun-sql installed and no other optional peer.
better-auth's password hooks on Bun.password. Needs better-auth and @better-auth/core (required peers); checked in a consumer with no optional peer.
